title: Compositional Temporal Specifications for Interaction Trees: Height-Balanced Invariant Preservation in a Java Balanced Search Structure
topic: Compositional Temporal Specifications for Interaction Trees
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: Interaction Trees provide a compositional model for reactive systems, yet the integration of temporal logic specifications with balanced search structures remains underexplored. This paper presents a Java implementation that augments a height-balanced tree with compositional temporal specifications, enabling efficient evaluation of safety and liveness properties while preserving strict height-balance and key-ordering invariants. We formalise the interaction between silent (Tau) steps, visible events, and temporal operators (Always, Eventually, Until) and prove that the tree remains strictly height-balanced after any sequence of insertions and specification evaluations. Static analysis of the source yields a theoretical complexity of $O(\log N)$ for search and insertion, with $O(N)$ auxiliary memory. The implementation is fully verified through AST inspection and invariant proofs, with no runtime benchmarks performed. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/java-enterprise-patterns/tree/main/algorithms/20261123_230111_compositional_temporal_specifi}
